title: DJIA Market Happenings For Tuesday, September 18, 2018
text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Tuesday, September 18, 2018 Posted by admin on September 18th, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include American Express (AXP), Nike (NKE), and Pfizer (PFE). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +120 points.
Monday the Dow was down -92.55 (-0.35%) at 26,062.12.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +5.43%.
There were 15 Dow stocks up Monday.
The Dow stock winners Monday were led by Caterpillar (CAT) +0.91% and 3M (MMM)
The Dow stock losers Monday were led by Apple (AAPL) -2.66% and McDonald’s (MCD) -1.68%.
Walmart (WMT +0.24%) was rated a new ‘Outperform’ at BMO Capital Markets with a price target of $110.
European stocks are higher and Asian markets ended higher.
The national average price of gasoline is down five-tenths of a cent at $2.846 per gallon.
Earnings Reports .
Nike (NKE) reports earnings on 9/25/2018 after the market close.
Today’s Featured Dow Stock
Disney (DIS)
Disney (DIS) is up +1.72% year-to-date.
